title: Lid and can did not feel sharp after opening.  Up-date , it’s not getting easier to open!
text:
Lid and can did not feel sharp after opening. Up-date , it’s not getting easier to open!. Update- the more I use this it’s Not getting easier to turn handle. For a man it’s ok, I’m a older women.
——————
I like the weight and feel of this can opener.
At first the turn handle was hard to use, but the more you use it the easier it does work ( I’m older).
This cut right into the can I was opening.
But the other day I was using this can opener , and I got it a little over 1/2 way around, and then it
Went off track of the tomato sauce can I was trying to open! I had to take a butter knife
To open this a bit more and get the sauce out!
I do not think the can was dented. But it could not get back on track, it just smashed the-can down!

I do like the thick wood handles. The way this cuts into a can I was surprised the can or
Lid did not feel sharp.
If I have another problem with this can opener I will be back to this review.
4 stars
